mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a chilly 33 degrees with overcast conditions near Badger Prairie County Park.

The City of Verona has announced pavement repairs for November 10 and 11. Crews will be milling and paving streets including North Nine Mound Road and Morningside Boulevard, so please note that no parking signs will be enforced from 7 AM to 7 PM.

Today, you can join a session at Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is plenty to do with trivia nights at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.
In our weekly report, officers noted that on October 25, a 40-year-old man was taken into custody for O W I after being found stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Stop by for a sweet treat today, as Culver's opens at 10:00 AM serving the delicious Devil's Food Cake flavor of the day.
